The '''LCK 2022 Summer''' Split was the second split of the 2022 season of the [[League of Legends Champions Korea]], organized by Riot Games. The competition ran from June 15 to August 28, with the Group Stage held at LoL Park in Seoul and the Grand Final played at Gangneung Arena in Gangneung. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Group Stage using best-of-three matches, with the top six advancing to a Single Elimination Playoffs played as best-of-five. The winner qualified for the [[World Championship/2022|2022 World Championship]]. The split was played on patches 12.10 through 12.14, with Bel’Veth and Nilah disabled at points due to balance considerations.

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' - ''June 15<sup>th</sup> - August 14<sup>th</sup>, 2022''
**Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 10th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
*'''Playoffs''' - ''August 17<sup>th</sup> - 28<sup>th</sup>, 2022''
** Single Elimination
** 1st placed team from group stage can choose the opponent from first round
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2022|World Championship 2022]]
